note: Snapshot of the parsed backlog so an installed package is self-contained.

ADV-001.text: Surface loft/boundary/sweep/fill, knit, trim, extend, offset, ruled surface, freeform, and thicken with continuity and curvature evidence.

ADV-002.text: Discrete G0/G1/G2 and minimum-curvature-radius checks, clearly labeled as sampling rather than proof of global quality/self-intersection.

ADV-003.text: Mold draft analysis, parting-line/surface plan, shut-off/core/ cavity references, tooling direction, and shrinkage; distinguish plan validation from actual core/cavity authoring.

ADV-004.text: Sheet-metal base flange/tab, edge/miter flange, hem, jog, bend, unfold/fold, corner relief, forming tool, gauge/K-factor, and flat-pattern validation/export.

ADV-005.text: Weldment 3D sketch, structural member, trim/extend, gusset, end cap, weld bead, cut-list update, and cut-list property/BOM export.

ADV-006.text: Engrave/emboss/deboss/wrap sketch text on planar/cylindrical faces, covering the FreeCAD ShapeString workflows.

ADV-007.text: Routing authoring for pipes/tubes/electrical routes only after type-library, add-in, and license evidence; include route endpoints, segments, fittings, bend radii, supports, clearance, and BOM.

ADV-008.text: Supplier-profile DFM rules for machining, sheet metal, laser cutting, FDM, and SLA with explicit missing-evidence blocking.

ASM-001.text: Insert part/subassembly at a transform with chosen configuration and optional fixed state.

ASM-002.text: Return a recursive component tree with path, referenced configuration, quantity, suppression, lightweight, hidden, fixed, envelope, virtual, and broken-reference state.

ASM-003.text: Resolve lightweight components; suppress/unsuppress; fix/float; show/hide; and set referenced configuration.

ASM-004.text: Get/set/reset component transforms and align a component to a feature/reference.

ASM-005.text: Rename, replace one/many by path, make independent, dissolve, create subassembly, mirror, and copy with mates.

ASM-006.text: Create virtual components and save externally under an explicit path policy.

ASM-007.text: Report broken/external/in-context references and dependency paths before replacement or Pack and Go.

AUTO-001.text: List/read/create/run/delete versioned macros only if macro execution is needed; validate language/module structure and apply an allowlist or explicit high-risk gate.

AUTO-002.text: Reusable parts/features library with search, metadata, insertion, configuration choice, transform, and dependency checks.

AUTO-003.text: Natural-language brief to a structured parametric plan with assumptions, unresolved engineering inputs, operation DAG, and review gates.

AUTO-004.text: URDF readiness: component tree, named link frames/joint axes, transforms, inertial properties, joint/mate limits, and missing-reference report.

AUTO-005.text: Add link coordinate systems, export versioned meshes/package manifest, and generate URDF with validation.

CON-001.text: Add/remove horizontal, vertical, coincident, collinear, parallel, perpendicular, tangent, equal, concentric, midpoint, symmetric, fix, and merge relations.

CON-002.text: Add distance, horizontal distance, vertical distance, radius, diameter, angle, and arc-length dimensions.

CON-003.text: Set/read a dimension in caller units, including tolerance, equation/driven state, name, and configuration scope.

CON-004.text: Auto-dimension a sketch only under an explicit policy and report every dimension/relation created.

CON-005.text: Validate under/over-defined state and dangling relations after every constraint batch.

DAT-001.text: List and inspect origin, standard/named planes, axes, points, coordinate systems, and temporary axes.

DAT-003.text: Create reference axes and points from structured entity inputs.

DAT-004.text: Create a coordinate system from origin and axis references and return its transform.

DAT-005.text: Rename, suppress, delete, and persistently reference datum features.

DISC-001.text: Search the registered tool catalog by name, domain, tags, and description.

DISC-002.text: Search a local, version-tagged SolidWorks API reference and warn when the installed version differs.

DISC-003.text: Provide an allowlisted read-only API/property invoker and an efficient batch form for multi-call inspection.

DISC-004.text: Gate low-level writes behind a separate configuration flag, confirmation, path policy, audit, and checkpoint.

DISC-005.text: Provide a tool/worker capability probe so callers can branch on edition, license, add-in, API signature, and verified-version evidence.

DOC-001.text: Create part, assembly, and drawing documents from explicit or discovered templates.

DOC-002.text: Open SLDPRT, SLDASM, SLDDRW, and supported neutral formats with decoded warnings/errors and optional read-only mode.

DOC-003.text: List open documents; inspect type, title, path, saved/dirty state, active configuration/sheet, units, and custom properties.

DOC-004.text: Activate a document by path/title and reject ambiguous matches.

DOC-005.text: Save, Save As, close one, and close all with explicit dirty-file behavior.

DOC-006.text: Rebuild/force rebuild and report feature/rebuild errors.

DOC-007.text: Native undo/redo and availability status, in addition to durable checkpoints.

DRW-001.text: Create a drawing from part/assembly using an explicit template, sheet size, projection standard, scale, units, and title-block/property mapping.

DRW-002.text: Add standard, projected, auxiliary, section, detail, broken-out, crop, relative, and exploded-model views with positions/scales.

DRW-003.text: List/inspect sheets and views, including referenced model/ configuration, orientation, scale, outline, alignment, and display style.

DRW-004.text: Import model items/dimensions and create drawing dimensions with placement, tolerances, precision, arrows, and formatting.

DRW-005.text: Create center marks/lines, hole callouts, datum symbols, GD&T, surface-finish, weld, balloon, revision, and general note annotations.

DRW-006.text: Create/update BOM, hole, revision, weldment cut-list, and general tables; inspect their rows/cells and component links.

DRW-007.text: Create additional sheets, change format/template, reorder views, and manage layer/line/font standards.

DRW-008.text: Inspect dimensions, notes, tables, dangling annotations, overlaps, clipping, empty views, and missing required views/callouts.

DRW-009.text: Export each sheet and full drawing to PDF/DXF/DWG/image and generate preview plus machine-readable review evidence.

DRW-010.text: Keep drawing visual acceptance human-reviewable; do not claim that approximate annotation bounding boxes prove a production drawing.

FEA-001.text: Preflight installed SolidWorks Simulation and/or allowlisted external solvers without arbitrary process execution.

FEA-002.text: Structured linear static study: materials, shells/solids/beams, connectors/contact, fixtures, loads, mesh, solve, and result extraction.

FEA-003.text: Constrained nonlinear/static plasticity/contact workflows only where inputs and solver support are explicit.

FEA-004.text: Mesh convergence across multiple levels using displacement, stress, strain, contact penetration, and pressure metrics as applicable.

FEA-005.text: Extract displacement, stress, strain, factor-of-safety/contact data and plots with units, mesh statistics, solver logs, and provenance.

FEA-006.text: Always mark FEA as review-required and never describe it as certification or proof of safety.

FEAT-001.text: Boss extrude with blind, through-all, up-to-surface/body, mid-plane, two-direction, thin-feature, draft, merge, and feature-scope options.

FEAT-002.text: Cut extrude with the same applicable end conditions and scope.

FEAT-003.text: Revolved boss/base and revolved cut with axis reference, direction, angle, and thin options.

FEAT-004.text: Sweep boss/cut with profile, path, guide curves, orientation, twist, and merge/scope options.

FEAT-005.text: Loft/boundary boss and cut across multiple profiles, with guide curves, start/end constraints, closed/centerline options, and read-back.

FEAT-006.text: Fillet variants and chamfer variants using stable edge/face references, not implicit current selection.

FEAT-007.text: Linear, circular, curve-driven, sketch-driven, table-driven, fill, and variable patterns with skipped instances.

FEAT-008.text: Mirror features, faces, bodies, and whole parts.

FEAT-009.text: Shell and thicken with face removal, direction, multi-thickness, and failure diagnostics.

FEAT-010.text: Draft by neutral plane/parting line/step draft with face lists and direction.

FEAT-011.text: Rib with thickness, direction, draft, contour, and merge scope.

FEAT-012.text: Hole Wizard/simple-hole support for blind, through, tapped, counterbore, countersink, spotface, and compound holes, including standard, size, fit, thread, end condition, and position sketch.

FEAT-013.text: Straight/arc/semicircular slots and hole/slot patterns with datum-based position acceptance.

FEAT-014.text: Direct/composed primitive workflows for box, cylinder, sphere, cone/frustum, torus, wedge, prism, regular polygon extrusion, and helix/spring.

FEAT-015.text: Rename, list, inspect, edit definition, reorder when safe, suppress/unsuppress, and delete features.

FEAT-016.text: List solid/surface bodies and map each body to owning features, material, visibility, and mass properties.

FEAT-017.text: Combine bodies with add/subtract/common; copy/move/rotate/scale, mirror, split, intersect, delete/keep, and save/clone a body to a part.

FEAT-018.text: Create/knit/trim/extend/offset surfaces and convert face/wire inputs where the API supports a stable implementation.

FEAT-019.text: Measure and inspect bounding box, volume, area, mass, center of mass, inertia, density, topology counts, and validity/rebuild state.

FEAT-020.text: Assign/read part, body, and component materials and optional mass override with explicit units.

IO-001.text: Import STEP, IGES, Parasolid, STL, and OBJ/mesh reference with options and import diagnostics.

IO-002.text: Export native/neutral formats as applicable: STEP, IGES, Parasolid, STL, 3MF, OBJ, GLB, BREP, DXF, DWG, PDF, PNG/BMP, and SVG.

IO-003.text: Expose tessellation/quality/unit/body-selection settings for mesh and neutral export and verify file type, size, timestamp, and reopen when feasible.

IO-004.text: Batch export multiple models/configurations/sheets/formats with a manifest, hashes, per-item status, and no silent overwrite.

IO-005.text: Export sheet-metal flat-pattern DXF with bend/sketch options and verify that a real flat pattern exists.

IO-006.text: Native Pack and Go with drawings, simulation results, Toolbox, external references, prefix/suffix/flatten options, dependency audit, and fallback policy.

IO-007.text: Export a component/property BOM CSV and a traceability matrix; retain a warning that it is a precursor until checked against a native BOM.

IO-008.text: Optionally provide CAD-free open-format writing, but keep it in a separate backend that never fabricates SLDPRT/SLDASM/SLDDRW.

MATE-001.text: Coincident, concentric, distance, angle, parallel, perpendicular, tangent, width, symmetric, lock, gear, rack-and-pinion, screw, universal-joint, slot, cam, hinge, linear-coupler, path, and coordinate-system mate contracts where supported by the installed version/license.

MATE-002.text: Limit-distance and limit-angle mates with read/update of min, max, current value, flip/alignment, and units.

MATE-003.text: Mate standard/named planes, origins, axes, faces, edges, vertices, and component coordinate systems through structured references.

MATE-004.text: List mates and mate entities; inspect type, alignment, suppression, status/error, owning components, and values.

MATE-005.text: Probe/dry-run candidate mate entities before mutation and return likely failure reasons.

MATE-006.text: Rename, suppress/unsuppress, edit, delete one/range/all, and replay a mate sequence with checkpoint rollback.

MATE-007.text: Report remaining assembly degrees of freedom and probe angular/ linear travel.

MATE-008.text: Run interference and clearance detection with component/body references and volume evidence.

MOTION-001.text: Detect/load Motion Study support and enumerate studies.

MOTION-002.text: Create/configure a study with type, duration, frame rate, and result folder.

MOTION-003.text: Add constant-speed/variable rotary and linear motors using stable geometry references.

MOTION-004.text: Add gravity, forces, torques, springs, dampers, contact, and friction when supported and licensed.

MOTION-005.text: Calculate and optionally play the study; capture solver status and result timestamps.

MOTION-006.text: Inspect and validate study type, duration, motor/force/contact counts, stale/missing results, and requested outputs.

MOTION-007.text: Export plots/data/animation evidence under controlled paths.

PAR-001.text: List, read, and update named driving dimensions with before/ after values and rebuild evidence.

PAR-002.text: Read and write equations/global variables, including dependency and circular-reference diagnostics.

PAR-003.text: List/create/copy/delete/rename configurations and set the active configuration.

PAR-004.text: Read and write configuration-specific dimension values and suppression states.

PAR-005.text: Import/export a parameter table (CSV/XLSX-neutral contract) and optionally connect it to a SolidWorks design table.

PAR-006.text: Read/write file-level and configuration-level custom properties, with evaluated and raw values.

PAR-007.text: Read/list display states and bind component appearance/visibility policies where appropriate.

REF-001.text: Inspect and clear the current selection; select by typed name and selection mark.

REF-002.text: Resolve documents, components, configurations, features, sketches, bodies, faces, edges, vertices, planes, axes, points, and coordinate systems by a structured reference.

REF-003.text: Capture and resolve SolidWorks persistent references (for example through model-extension persist-reference APIs).

REF-004.text: Provide semantic fallback references using component path, feature ancestry, geometry type, location, direction, radius/area, and tolerances.

REF-005.text: Expose selection probes: ray-to-face, planar-face lookup, cylindrical-face lookup, feature faces, body ownership, and candidate mate entities.

REF-006.text: Detect stale/ambiguous references and return candidates rather than silently choosing the first face or edge.

REF-007.text: Make entity reference objects serializable so workflows can checkpoint and resume.

REV-001.text: Inspect document, feature tree, sketches, bodies, configurations, equations, dimensions, properties, components, mates, sheets, views, and external references without mutation.

REV-002.text: Validate rebuild state, invalid geometry, zero/negative volume, topology changes, missing references, suppressed/dangling features, and dirty state.

REV-003.text: Capture before/after geometry measurements and previews for mutations.

REV-004.text: Inspect holes/slots by B-Rep geometry and compare quantity, diameter/segments, depth, axis, and datum position against acceptance criteria.

REV-005.text: Produce structured JSON plus human-readable Markdown review reports with pass/warn/block outcomes and source artifact hashes.

REV-006.text: Provide an atomic `safe_execute` workflow: checkpoint, mutate, rebuild, validate selected invariants, and roll back on failure.

REV-007.text: Make review policies caller-supplied and domain-specific; a file existence check is not an engineering validation.

SAFE-001.text: Give every operation a strict schema, bounded collection sizes, enum values, and finite/range checks for geometry inputs.

SAFE-002.text: Classify tools as read-only, model mutation, destructive model mutation, or non-model side effect.

SAFE-003.text: Require explicit confirmation for destructive operations and overwrites.

SAFE-004.text: Restrict input/output paths to configured roots, canonicalize paths, reject traversal, and distinguish existing inputs from new outputs.

SAFE-005.text: Checkpoint before risky mutations; list and restore checkpoints.

SAFE-006.text: Keep an append-only audit record for writes, including tool, normalized arguments, document, result, checkpoint, timestamp, and error.

SAFE-007.text: Support dry-run/preflight where the API allows it, especially for mates, selection, export, replacement, and delivery packaging.

SAFE-008.text: Use versioned output filenames or explicit overwrite policies; never silently replace engineering deliverables.

SAFE-009.text: Return stable error codes plus decoded SolidWorks save/open/ rebuild/mate errors and actionable remediation.

SAFE-010.text: Do not advertise success until the operation is read back from the model, filesystem, or analysis result.

SK-001.text: Start a 2D sketch on a standard plane, named plane, planar face, or structured reference; exit a sketch and report active sketch state.

SK-002.text: List and inspect sketches, including geometry, constraints, construction state, fully-defined state, and transform/support.

SK-003.text: Create line, centerline, point, corner/center rectangle, circle, three-point/center arc, ellipse, regular polygon, straight/arc slot, and spline.

SK-005.text: Project/convert external geometry and return stable references to the created entities.

SK-006.text: Delete sketch geometry and delete constraints by stable index/id.

SK-007.text: Trim, extend, split, offset, mirror, move, rotate, scale, and pattern sketch entities.

SK-008.text: Create sketch text with font/alignment/path options so engraving, emboss, and wrap workflows do not require arbitrary macros.

SYS-001.text: Attach to a running SolidWorks instance and optionally start a visible instance.

SYS-002.text: Report installed SolidWorks version/service pack, COM registration, process/session identity, active document, and add-in/type-library availability.

SYS-003.text: Serialize all SolidWorks COM calls on one STA-compatible worker or session queue; reject accidental concurrent mutation.

SYS-004.text: Detect busy/rejected COM calls and implement bounded retry with useful error classification.

SYS-005.text: Provide health, latency, worker mutex/session, and dependency diagnostics without requiring an active document.

SYS-006.text: Normalize user units while preserving the SolidWorks API's internal meter/radian conventions. Support at least mm, cm, m, inch, and foot.

SYS-007.text: Resolve localized standard plane/view names and avoid assuming an English feature tree.

VIEW-001.text: Set/read document, body, feature, face, and component appearance; support colors, transparency, and named material values.

VIEW-002.text: Set component/body/feature visibility and display mode.

VIEW-003.text: Set front/back/left/right/top/bottom/isometric/trimetric/dimetric views, fit, zoom, and custom camera orientation/position.

VIEW-004.text: Capture a PNG/BMP preview at requested dimensions after clearing selection and fitting the model.

VIEW-005.text: Create/read exploded views and optionally export animation frames where stable.
